summary: High-angle classroom scene monitoring two foreground students reading books. Reader A continuously stays focused on his book, turning a page around 4.75 seconds. Reader B reads her book while following along until 11 seconds (turning a page around 9.75 seconds), after which she turns her head away from the book.

segments.reason: Maintains a steady downward head orientation looking at the open book on his desk throughout.

segments.reason: Head is oriented towards the open book on her desk while reading.
